'''2000 European Championship Maarten Rossou DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Rossou]]
* '''Event:''' [[2000 European Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 2nd
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 HD Rossou DS 2000 Euro.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Thanks to Joeri Hoste for bringing Maarten Rossou's decks to the Web site!
